t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Ngoyé mondo dola, ô, Moténgbé gna, mbètè hokia moumo mémbo, mou mo séké-koundio. Ngoyo mou nzonzonzo na boli gna, na lomba Nzio, ikèlé gna na louélé ma Nzio. Moténgbé gna wé; mo kalissia bando lo na, Ndaha mossiki iko mou kini.
